description: Sixteen fixed voltages, each typed on its own display and each with a gate that switches it on, plus an output carrying the sum of them all

inputs.text: A gate for that row: with a cable patched here the row's output carries its voltage while the gate is over 10V and 0V otherwise, and with nothing patched the row's voltage is always on
A gate for the summed output: with a cable patched here the sum is carried while the gate is high

outputs.text: Carries the voltage set on that row while the row is on, and 0V while its gate holds it off
The sum of all sixteen voltages, counting the rows whose gates hold them off as well

notes: each row's voltage is typed or dragged on its own display rather than set with a knob
the Constants prefill loads pi, two pi, e, the square root of 2, one over the square root of 2 and phi
menu: PREFILL COMMANDS — fills all sixteen rows at once, with SEMITONES, VOLTAGES from -6v, VOLTAGES from 0v, Doubling VOLTAGES from 0.0625v, Doubling VOLTAGES from 1v or Constants
Polyphony channels — sends the row voltages out of the first row's output on one polyphonic cable, with the number of channels chosen there
Monophonic — leaves the first row's output carrying its own voltage alone
